Remark
[Covariant derivative components of $(0,2)$- and $(1,1)$-tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0092 ↗ def:pet-ch2-christoffel-symbols-second-kind ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-index-notation

1. ch2:2.5.24If $T_{k\ell }=T(\partial _k,\partial _\ell )$, then \[ ( abla T)_{jk\ell } =\partial _jT_{k\ell } -\Gamma ^m_{jk}T_{m\ell } -\Gamma ^m_{j\ell }T_{km}. \] For a $(1,1)$-tensor, \[ ( abla T)^k_{ji} =\partial _jT^k_i-\Gamma ^\ell _{ji}T^k_\ell +\Gamma ^k_{j\ell }T^\ell _i. \] The $(0,2)$ formula is formalized. The mixed-tensor representation needed for the $(1,1)$ formula is deferred, as in item 3.
